gen-yuji-mai-fs-literata: Yuji Mai walks through each word with a measured, spaced-out beat, its letters nearly sealed shut. But Literata leaves its curves wide open and keeps its thin strokes sturdy, so a brief stretch of text goes down comfortably.
gen-zen-dots-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One stands tall in the middle, with shallow ascenders and descenders and a generous entry into each e. Zen Dots does spacious and techy; Fauna One does literary and dignified.
gen-zen-dots-gf-glegoo: Techy and spacious: Zen Dots gives every letter room, while Glegoo fills the line with big counters and a tall lowercase. Generous openings run through both fonts, whatever the weight.
gen-zen-dots-gf-hanuman: Room around every letter defines Zen Dots, while Hanuman brings a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s. Both keep their shapes open and unhurried, which is the real draw here.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, with a big entrance into each curved letter and lowercase bodies filling most of the height. Zen Dots brings the spacious, techy shapes up front.
gen-zen-dots-gf-piazzolla: Refined from the first line, Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly level with the capitals and opens its e like a pried clasp. Zen Dots leads; paragraphs after it read steadily and with authority.
gen-almendra-display-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern, with gaps in its curves that stay generous. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, so paragraphs in Amulya keep moving without a snag.
gen-almendra-display-fs-chillax: Chillax draws its line like spaghetti laid out in letters, with pen-lifted curves that leave each loop unfinished. But Almendra Display stands ornate above it, so text below it drifts along loose and casual.
gen-almendra-display-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps vertical and horizontal strokes identical in weight, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Almendra Display adds a touch of calligraphic shading that Spline Sans skips entirely.
gen-almendra-display-fs-synonym: Ornate meets orderly: Almendra Display flourishes with a pronounced x-height and literary letters that never pinch shut. Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, so paragraphs move along steadily.
